19089-a-pagan-of-the-hills.title: A Pagan Of The Hills
19089-a-pagan-of-the-hills.creator: Charles Neville Buck
19089-a-pagan-of-the-hills.description: A book by Charles Neville Buck. Parson Acup, so called for the funereal gravity of his bearing and expression, and Brent the timber-buyer, stood looking down from beetling cliffs rigidly bestowed with collossal and dripping icicles. To their ears came a babel of shouts, the grating of trees, long sleet-bound but stirring now to the thaw--the roar of blasting powder and the rending of solid rock.

25998-the-riflemen-of-the-ohio-a-story-o.title: A Story of Early Days along "The Beautiful River"
25998-the-riflemen-of-the-ohio-a-story-o.creator: Joseph A. Altsheler
25998-the-riflemen-of-the-ohio-a-story-o.description: A book by Joseph A. Altsheler. The fleet of boats and canoes bearing supplies for the far east turned from the Mississippi into the wide mouth of the Ohio, and it seemed, for a time, that they had come into a larger river instead of a tributary.

arxiv-1811-07518.title: Corrected pair correlation functions for environments with obstacles
arxiv-1811-07518.creator: Stuart T. Johnston 1,2, Edmund J. Crampin 1,2,3
arxiv-1811-07518.description: Abstract Environments with immobile obstacles or void regions that inhibit and alter the motion of individuals within that environment are ubiquitous. Correlation in the location of individuals within such environments arises as a combination of the mechanisms governing individual behavior and the heterogeneous structure of the environment.

arxiv-2103-00778.title: Explaining Adversarial Vulnerability with a Data Sparsity Hypothesis
arxiv-2103-00778.creator: Mahsa Paknezhad, Hwee Kuan Lee
arxiv-2103-00778.description: Abstract Despite many proposed algorithms to provide robustness to deep learning (DL) models, DL models remain susceptible to adversarial attacks. We hypothesize that the adversarial vulnerability of DL models stems from two factors. The first factor is data sparsity which is that in the high dimensional input data space, there exist large regions outside the support of the data distribution.

arxiv-2108-04171.creator: Mohamed Mahmoud Chems-Eddin
arxiv-2108-04171.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mohamed Mahmoud Chems-Eddin. arxiv-2207-08254.title: Improving tobacco social contagion models using agent-based simulations on networks
arxiv-2207-08254.creator: Adarsh Prabhakaran
arxiv-2207-08254.description: Abstract Abstract Over the years, population-level tobacco control policies have considerably reduced smoking prevalence worldwide. However, the rate of decline of smoking prevalence is slowing down. Therefore, there is a need for models that capture the full complexity of the smoking epidemic.

arxiv-2303-04765.title: Lorentz and CPT breaking in gamma-ray burst neutrinos from string theory Published as JHEP 03 (2023) 230, https://doi.org/10.1007/JHEP03(2023)230 arXiv: 2303.04765
arxiv-2303-04765.creator: Chengyi Li, and Bo-Qiang Ma
arxiv-2303-04765.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Chengyi Li, and Bo-Qiang Ma. Previous studies on high-energy gamma-ray burst neutrinos from IceCube suggest a neutrino speed variation at the Lorentz violation (LV) scale of ∼ 6.4 × 10 17 \sim 6.4\times 10^{17} GeV, with opposite velocity variances between neutrinos and antineutrinos. Within a space-time foam model, inspired by string theory, we develop an approach to describe the suggested neutrino/antineutrino propagation properties with both Lorentz invariance and CPT symmetry breaking.

arxiv-2307-09032.title: Isotonic conditional laws
arxiv-2307-09032.creator: Sebastian Arnold, Johanna Ziegel
arxiv-2307-09032.description: Abstract We introduce isotonic conditional laws (ICL) which extend the classical notion of conditional laws by the additional requirement that there exists an isotonic relationship between the random variable of interest and the conditioning random object. We show existence and uniqueness of ICL building on conditional expectations given σ \sigma -lattices.

arxiv-2403-11698.title: Spin-Orbital Ordering in Alkali Superoxides
arxiv-2403-11698.creator: Kohei Shibata, Makoto Naka, Harald O. Jeschke, Junya Otsuki
arxiv-2403-11698.description: Abstract Akali superoxides A O 2 \text{A\/O}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}} ( A = Na A=\textrm{Na} , K, Rb, Cs), due to an open p p shell of the oxygen ion O 2 \text{O}{\vphantom{\text{X}}}_{\smash[t]{\text{2}}} - with degenerate π \pi orbitals, have spin and orbital degrees of freedom.

arxiv-2410-09992.title: Evaluating Gender Bias of LLMs in Making Morality Judgements
arxiv-2410-09992.creator: Divij Bajaj Yuanyuan Lei Jonathan Tong Ruihong Huang Department of Computer Science and Engineering Texas A&M University, College Station, TX {divij.bajaj, yuanyuan, tongjo, huangrh}@tamu.edu
arxiv-2410-09992.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in a multitude of Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks. However, these models are still not immune to limitations such as social biases, especially gender bias. This work investigates whether current closed and open-source LLMs possess gender bias, especially when asked to give moral opinions.

arxiv-2502-09637.title: Meta-Cultural Competence: Climbing the Right Hill of Cultural Awareness
arxiv-2502-09637.creator: Sougata Saha, Saurabh Kumar Pandey, Monojit Choudhury
arxiv-2502-09637.description: Abstract Numerous recent studies have shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) are biased towards a Western and Anglo-centric worldview, which compromises their usefulness in non-Western cultural settings. However, “culture” is a complex, multifaceted topic, and its awareness, representation, and modeling in LLMs and LLM-based applications can be defined and measured in numerous ways.

arxiv-2511-04612.title: Asymptotics of constrained M M -estimation under convexity
arxiv-2511-04612.creator: Victor-Emmanuel Brunel
arxiv-2511-04612.description: Abstract M M -estimation, aka empirical risk minimization, is at the heart of statistics and machine learning: Classification, regression, location estimation, etc. Asymptotic theory is well understood when the loss satisfies some smoothness assumptions and its derivatives are dominated locally. However, these conditions are typically technical and can be too restrictive or heavy to check.

arxiv-2602-15378.title: Making Large Language Models Speak Tulu: Structured Prompting for an Extremely Low-Resource Language
arxiv-2602-15378.creator: Prathamesh Devadiga, Paras Chopra
arxiv-2602-15378.description: Abstract Can large language models converse in languages virtually absent from their training data? We investigate this question through a case study on Tulu, a Dravidian language with over 2 million speakers but minimal digital presence. Rather than fine-tuning an LLM, we examine whether structured prompts alone can elicit basic conversational ability under controlled prompting.

arxiv-2603-25178.title: Bilingual Text-to-Motion Generation: A New Benchmark and Baselines
arxiv-2603-25178.creator: Wanjiang Weng, Xiaofeng Tan, Xiangbo Shu, Guo-Sen Xie, Pan Zhou, Hongsong Wang

europmc-pmc6506551.description: Once considered the exclusive property of metal complexes, the phenomenon of room-temperature phosphorescence (RTP) has been increasingly realized in pure organic luminophores recently. Using precise molecular design and synthetic approaches to modulate their weak spin-orbit...

openalex-w3010658582.creator: Qiangyi Yu, Liangzhi You, Ulrike Wood‐Sichra, Yating Ru, Alison B. Joglekar, Steffen Fritz, Wei Xiong, Miao Lu, Wenbin Wu, Peng Yang

Data on global agricultural production are usually available as statistics at administrative units, which does not give any diversity and spatial patterns thus is less informative for subsequent spatially explicit agricultural and environmental analyses. In the second...

pmc-10485731.title: The Prevalence, Severity, and Predictive Factors of Restless Legs Syndrome in Pregnancy
pmc-10485731.creator: Hasan Turan, Suna Aşkın Turan, Zafer Butun, Masum Kayapınar
pmc-10485731.description: Objectives: The current study aimed to search the prevalence and severity of restless legs syndrome (RLS) in pregnancy according to the three trimesters and predictive factors of RLS in pregnancy based on validated diagnostic tools and a thorough literature review.Methods: The cross-sectional descriptive study included 500 pregnant women without comorbidities who were interviewed face-to-face.

pmc-11391846.title: Managing malignant sublingual gland tumors: a single institution experience with 23 patients
pmc-11391846.creator: Shi-Long Zhang, Zhou-Yang Wu, Ren-Xiu Fan, Jun Jia, Zi-Li Yu
pmc-11391846.description: BackgroundDue to the relative rarity of malignant sublingual gland tumors, diagnosing and treating them clinically pose challenges. Hence, there’s a need to explore the pathological types, characteristics, treatment methods, and prognosis of primary malignant tumors of the sublingual gland to improve our understanding and management of these rare yet highly malignant conditions.

pmc-11495087.title: The impact of changing exposure to PM2.5 on mortality for US diplomats with multiple international relocations: a modelling study
pmc-11495087.creator: Leslie Edwards, James Milner, Paul Wilkinson, Ai Milojevic
pmc-11495087.description: BackgroundCurrent evidence linking long-term exposure to fine particulate matter (PM2.5) exposure and mortality is primarily based on persons that live in the same residence, city and/or country throughout the study, with few residential moves or relocations. We propose a novel method to quantify the health impacts of PM2.

pmc-12309729.title: Foot Measurements From Three‐Dimensional Scans: Elinvision 3DST Reliability
pmc-12309729.creator: Petra J Jones, Alex V Rowlands, Melanie J Davies, David Webb, Clare L Gillies, Alam Shah
pmc-12309729.description: Background3D foot scanners such as the Elinvision 3DST foot scanner potentially offer a faster, alternative method to traditional plaster casting to produce orthotics or therapeutic footwear.Objective(s)To assess the reliability of 3DST‐derived foot length, orthogonal ball width, heel width and ball girth. We also compared 3D scanner and manually derived measures.Study DesignRepeated measures design.

pmc-12388843.title: Targeted LC-MS Orbitrap Method for the Analysis of Azaarenes, and Nitrated and Oxygenated PAHs in Road Paving Emissions
pmc-12388843.creator: Maria Bou Saad, Sylvain Ravier, Amandine Durand, Brice Temime-Roussel, Vincent Gaudefroy, Audrey Pevere, Henri Wortham, Pierre Doumenq
pmc-12388843.description: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH) derivatives, specifically azaarenes and nitrated and oxygenated PAHs, are emerging contaminants of concern due to their increased toxicity and persistence compared to the parent PAHs. Despite their toxicity, their simultaneous analysis in complex matrices, such as in fumes emitted from bituminous mixtures, remains challenging due to limitations of conventional analytical techniques.

pmc-12495556.title: Placebo response to intra-articular injections in knee osteoarthritis: magnitude, evolution over time, and influencing factors. A systematic review and meta-analysis with meta-regression
pmc-12495556.creator: Davide Previtali, Angelo Boffa, Giorgio Di Laura Frattura, Giulia Merli, Giuseppe Filardo
pmc-12495556.description: PurposeTo quantify the response to intra-articular saline administration in terms of pain, function, and quality of life, with a focus on the evolution of placebo response over time and the identification of influencing factors on the placebo response to knee osteoarthritis injections.

pmc-12516374.title: Recent Advancements in 20S Proteasome Enhancement: Degradation of Undruggable Targets
pmc-12516374.creator: Sydney G. Cobb, Jetze J. Tepe
pmc-12516374.description: The ubiquitin-independent proteasome system has emerged as an attractive point of intervention for a variety of diseases, including neurodegenerative diseases. Though inhibition of this system has been studied for decades, 20S proteasome enhancement is much younger by comparison, but substantial levels of progress have been made in this field especially within the last five years.

pmc-12743657.title: Who Truly Benefits From First-Line Intensification in EGFR-Mutant NSCLC?
pmc-12743657.creator: Michele Maffezzoli, Jason Lau, Samuel Justin, Dawood Misbah, Giuseppe Luigi Banna
pmc-12743657.description: Purpose of ReviewThe treatment landscape for advanced non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) with common EGFR mutations has evolved significantly, with osimertinib established as the first-line standard. Two recent phase III trials, FLAURA2 and MARIPOSA, demonstrated that first-line intensification—through osimertinib plus chemotherapy or amivantamab–lazertinib—significantly prolongs overall survival compared to osimertinib alone.

pmc-13251708.title: Clinical perspectives on pediatric weight-management programs: A nationwide look at models of care
pmc-13251708.creator: Niharika Alla, Jacqueline Chan, Rushika Conroy
pmc-13251708.description: BackgroundObesity is a common, complex, and often persistent chronic disease associated with serious health and social consequences. In the United States, recent data indicates that almost 20% of children and adolescents have obesity. Management of pediatric obesity involves multidisciplinary teams, including pediatricians, pediatric specialists, dietitians, behavioral health specialists, and exercise professionals, who deliver intensive health behavior and lifestyle treatment.

pmc-13300833.title: Navigation-Assisted Bilateral Troughing Technique for Lumbar Laminectomy: A Stepwise Approach to Safe, Teachable, and Efficient Decompression
pmc-13300833.creator: Imran Siddiqi, Allison Shay, Arisa Ueno, Stanley Dennison, Christopher Wong, Sanjay C Rao, Raed Sweiss, Dan E Miulli
pmc-13300833.description: Lumbar laminectomy is one of the most common spinal procedures, yet the extent of bone removal remains highly operator-dependent, resulting in significant variability in decompression outcomes. Insufficient decompression risks symptom persistence, while over-resection of the facet joints causes iatrogenic instability, and uncontrolled instrument passes near the inner lamina cortex carry well-documented risk of dural injury and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) leak.

pmc-13552014.title: Bridge-Enhanced Anterior Cruciate Ligament Repair versus Autograft Reconstruction in Anterior Cruciate Ligament Surgery
pmc-13552014.creator: Sanjeevi Bharadwaj, Naveen Jeyaraman, Subasri Balasubramanian, Arunagiri Gunasekar, Arulkumar Nallakumarasamy, Madhan Jeyaraman
pmc-13552014.description: Introduction:Surgical repair of the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) using an autograft is the accepted standard treatment for symptomatic ACL tears, but morbidity associated with the harvest of the autograft, residual laxity, and the possibility of a second injury and post-traumatic osteoarthritis have brought about renewed interest in biologic repair.
